title: BehaveRec: When Does Long-Term Behavioral History Help Sequential Recommendation? A Study with Session, History, and Community Signals
abstract: arXiv:2610.36239v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sequential recommendation models typically predict a user's next action from recent session interactions, which limits personalization when short-term signals are weak or ambiguous. Rather than assuming that incorporating longer-term history and community signals is universally beneficial, we study when it actually helps. We propose BehaveRec, a three-signal framework combining a causal session transformer, a bidirectional User History Encoder over a 90-day window, and a GraphSAGE module over a user-user graph built from behavioral embedding similarity rather than item co-occurrence; a learned gate blends the three signals per user. On an industrial dataset of 137M sequences from 12.6M users, BehaveRec improves R@5 by +3.2% over SASRec, with a larger-capacity SASRec baseline (more parameters than BehaveRec) still trailing by +2.5%, ruling out capacity as the explanation. translated_title: BehaveRec：长期行为历史何时有助于序列推荐？——基于会话、历史与社区信号的研究
translated_abstract: 序列推荐模型通常根据用户近期的会话交互来预测其下一个动作，这在短期信号较弱或模糊时会限制个性化效果。我们并不假设引入更长期的历史和社区信号总是有益，而是研究它们何时真正有效。我们提出了BehaveRec，这是一个三信号框架，结合了因果会话transformer、覆盖90天窗口的双向用户历史编码器，以及在用户-用户图上运行的GraphSAGE模块（该图基于行为嵌入相似度而非物品共现构建）；一个可学习的门控机制为每个用户自适应融合这三种信号。在一个包含1260万用户的1.37亿条序列的工业数据集上，BehaveRec将R@5相比SASRec提升了3.2%，而一个容量更大的SASRec基线（参数量多于BehaveRec）仍然落后2.5%，排除了模型容量作为解释。更重要的是，按历史长度进行的用户级分层分析揭示（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出三信号框架BehaveRec，通过可学习门控融合短期会话、90天长期用户历史和基于行为嵌入相似度的社区信号，在1.37亿条序列的工业数据集上超越了更大容量的SASRec基线，并系统研究了长期历史信号何时真正对推荐有效。
en_tdlr: BehaveRec is a three-signal framework that adaptively fuses session, 90-day long-term history, and community (GraphSAGE) signals via a learned gate, outperforming even a larger-capacity SASRec baseline on an industrial dataset of 137M sequences, and systematically revealing when long-term behavioral history actually helps sequential recommendation.
